title: Universal Evidence Universe — the five classes of evidence and what each may touch
authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH. This register legislates what evidence IS and what it may influence. It is upstream of every producer it describes and must never be generated by one of them.
why_this_exists: The repository always held evidence. What it lacked was a statement of what evidence IS, so each
surface was governed by whichever list happened to mention it: .gitignore decided the
version-control boundary, exclusion-register.json decided the cleanliness class, and NOTHING
decided whether a producer could read a surface while rendering a canonical artifact.
UAKOS-CLOSURE-008 is what that gap looks like when it fires. `evidence/verify.log` was read at
render time and its tail embedded in 06-VALIDATION-REPORT.md; 04-REPOSITORY-CHANGE-REGISTER.md
then recorded the hash that followed. Two canonical artifacts carried one machine's stdout, and
the question 'was that allowed?' had no owner competent to answer it.
Phase 9 discovered that. A universe declares it in advance: every surface has a class, a class
has rules, and a producer that reads a surface is bound by them before the artifact exists.

evidence_classes.AUDIT: Who did what, recorded so an act can be reviewed after the fact. Supports accountability; never repository identity.
evidence_classes.DEBUG: A trace kept to diagnose a specific failure. Kept as long as it is useful; may never influence certification.
evidence_classes.IMPROVEMENT: A measurement kept to decide what to change next. Informs planning; may never influence certification.
evidence_classes.EXECUTION: What a command emitted when it ran — stdout, stderr, timings, counts. A historical observation of one event on one machine.
evidence_classes.VALIDATION: The deterministic derived result of checking something. The one class that MAY be repository truth, and only when it is derived from repository truth and tracked.

constitutional_rules.meaning: Every surface is owned, produced by a named producer, retained under a declared policy, and may be read, cited and published. Nothing in this register restricts the KEEPING of evidence. A rule that made evidence inconvenient to keep would buy determinism with amnesia.
constitutional_rules.enforced_by: evidence_universe.validate — owner, producer and retention are required on every surface

constitutional_rules.rule: Evidence may never SILENTLY become identity.
constitutional_rules.meaning: Every surface carries canonical_identity_role NON_CANONICAL and declares the input classification a consumer is obliged to use. A canonical artifact that consumes a surface is then a declared and visible fact, never an accident discovered downstream.

constitutional_rules.rule: Execution observations cannot influence canonical hashes.
constitutional_rules.meaning: AUDIT, DEBUG, IMPROVEMENT and EXECUTION surfaces map to input classifications that a CANONICAL artifact may not declare. VALIDATION is the single class that may be TRACKED_DETERMINISTIC, because a derived result is repository truth exactly when it is derived from repository truth and committed with it.

constitutional_rules.rule: Debug and improvement artifacts cannot affect certification.
constitutional_rules.meaning: may_affect_certification is false for both classes by construction, and any registered artifact carrying a certification_role that names such a surface as an input is a finding. Certification states what the repository IS; a diagnosis of one failure and a plan for the next change are neither.

invariants: Every declared class is one of AUDIT, DEBUG, IMPROVEMENT, EXECUTION, VALIDATION — the set is closed.
Every surface carries an owner, a producer, a retention policy and an input classification.
Every surface is NON_CANONICAL. Evidence is preserved; it makes no identity claim.
Only a VALIDATION surface may be classified TRACKED_DETERMINISTIC.
No DEBUG or IMPROVEMENT surface may affect certification.
Every execution-observation input named by any registered artifact resolves to a surface declared here.
Only a VALIDATION surface may be consumed by a canonical artifact, and only as a declared generated input. AUDIT, DEBUG, IMPROVEMENT and EXECUTION surfaces are referenced by id.
not_in_this_universe: data/_evidence/<unit>/ excluding URI-000001 — 123 TRACKED canonical certification artifacts (UCOS-DATA-*). They are named 'evidence' but are authored/derived repository truth committed with the corpus, not an evidence surface. Their governance belongs to the generated-artifact registry, not here.
__pycache__/, *.pyc, .pytest_cache/, .ruff_cache/, .mypy_cache/ — caches carry no information not present in their source; they are not evidence of anything.

surfaces.retention: PRESERVED per clone; regenerated each run

surfaces.retention: PRESERVED. Referenced by identity from 00-MASTER/UAKOS-CLOSURE-008/validation-record.json as UAKOS-CLOSURE-008/EV-VERIFY-001; never read to render an artifact.
surfaces.note: Declared by name because it is the surface whose consumption produced UAKOS-CLOSURE-008. The canonical layer now reads a deterministic validation record and cites this transcript by id.

surfaces.owner: the 00-MASTER programme that owns the containing directory
surfaces.producer: 00-MASTER programme engines (proof, compliance, snapshot and evidence-index emitters)
surfaces.retention: PRESERVED per clone; deterministically regenerated from tracked declarations each run
surfaces.note: Derived from tracked declarations and therefore deterministic in CONTENT — but excluded from version control, so it is absent from a pristine clone. OPERATIONAL rather than TRACKED_DETERMINISTIC for exactly that reason: determinism of derivation does not make an untracked file repository truth.

surfaces.retention: REGENERATED each run; excluded from version control by determinism-evidence/
surfaces.note: The determinism proof set. Deterministic by construction and still absent from a pristine clone until the prerequisite stage runs. Classified GENERATED_DETERMINISTIC rather than OPERATIONAL because it is a VALIDATION surface derived from tracked sources: R-EV-3 admits exactly this class into canonical identity, and only once generated_inputs names its producer and bootstrap path.

surfaces.retention: REGENERATED by `python -m intelligence.realization realize`; excluded from version control
surfaces.note: The one subtree of data/_evidence/ that is generated. Its 123 tracked siblings are canonical artifacts and are deliberately outside this universe. Classified GENERATED_DETERMINISTIC rather than OPERATIONAL because it is a VALIDATION surface derived from tracked sources: R-EV-3 admits exactly this class into canonical identity, and only once generated_inputs names its producer and bootstrap path.

surfaces.retention: PER-CLONE runtime audit log; never tracked, never shared
surfaces.note: Enforcement / synchronization / certification audit records. This is the permanent remediation for telemetry-induced non-determinism: the audit trail exists, and nothing derives identity from it.

surfaces.retention: REGENERATED by every test run; excluded from version control
surfaces.note: An observation of one test execution: which lines a particular run happened to reach. UCOS-CL-005 is what happens when a canonical artifact reads it; three producers still do, and each is a declared identity defect in the generated-artifact registry.

surfaces.retention: PER-CLONE. Records what this working copy is configured to do — remotes, upstreams, hooks.
surfaces.note: Declared because URRC-000001 used to render `git remote` and `git rev-parse @{u}` output into two tracked artifacts, so the same commit produced different bytes on a machine with an upstream and one without. URRC now states the non-derivability as a declared claim and cites this surface by id (URRC-000001/EV-UPSTREAM-001).

surfaces.retention: REGENERATED by every test run; excluded from version control
surfaces.note: The binary coverage database behind coverage.xml, including parallel-mode shards.

declared_empty_classes.DEBUG: No surface is declared. The class exists so the first trace anyone keeps to diagnose a failure lands in a class that already has a rule, rather than arriving unclassified and being discovered by a phase gate. A DEBUG surface may never affect certification (R-EV-4).
declared_empty_classes.IMPROVEMENT: No surface is declared. Same reason: the first improvement measurement kept in-tree is already governed. Planning artifacts that are AUTHORED repository truth (backlogs, roadmaps, gap analyses) are canonical artifacts, not evidence, and are not this class.
